accessible_name: The joining grid for transitive closure
boundary_chains: M through P subscript one to P subscript m
M through Q subscript one to Q subscript n
common_endpoint: N at row m and column n
long_description: The grid has m plus one rows and n plus one columns, indexed from zero. M is at the upper left. The P chain follows the left column downward; the Q chain follows the top row rightward. Each interior entry is a common successor of its upper and left neighbors. All vertical arrows point down and all horizontal arrows point right. The bottom row and rightmost column finish at the same lower right entry.
